title: Popular pets: where each one comes from

source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

origin.match: Match each pet to where it comes from.
origin.reverse: Which of these pets comes from {value}?

rows.label: cat
rows.hook: purrs, chases mice, and is the most popular household companion in the world

rows.label: axolotl
rows.origin: Mexico (the lake beds around Mexico City)
rows.hook: is a pink-gilled amphibian that stays in its larval form and can regrow lost limbs

rows.label: guinea pig
rows.origin: The Andes Mountains of South America (Peru)
rows.hook: is a small, squeaky rodent kept as a pet and once raised for food in the highlands

rows.label: Budgerigar
rows.hook: is a small, colorful parakeet that is a popular pet and can learn to mimic speech

rows.label: Sugar glider
rows.hook: is a tiny marsupial pet that glides between trees using a membrane stretched between its limbs

rows.label: koi
rows.description: form of Cyprinus rubrofuscus (previously categorized as Cyprinus carpio)
rows.hook: is a colorful ornamental carp kept in outdoor ponds and prized for its patterns

rows.label: Siamese fighting fish
rows.hook: is a brightly colored, flowing-finned aquarium pet where males are famously aggressive with each other

rows.label: Cockatiel
rows.hook: is a small crested pet bird with orange cheek patches, known for whistling and mimicry

rows.label: goldfish
rows.description: species of freshwater fish, common in aquariums
rows.hook: is the classic prize at a carnival game, often won in a plastic bag of water

rows.label: Corn snake
rows.hook: is a docile, orange-and-red patterned constrictor that is a popular beginner reptile pet

rows.label: Ball python
rows.hook: is a docile constrictor that curls itself into a tight coil when frightened

rows.label: Grey Parrot
rows.origin: The rainforests of West and Central Africa
rows.hook: is a bird with a red tail, renowned as one of the most talkative and intelligent pets

rows.label: fancy rat
rows.hook: is a tame, sociable domesticated rodent kept as a pet, bred in many colors and coat types
